'''Barricades''' can be found during the [[Pest Control]] [[minigame]]. The monsters during the minigame will deal damage to the barricades, causing them to be destroyed and lose efficacy. Players can repair the barricades with a [[hammer]] and a [[logs|log]]; repairing them to full health, as well as granting the player a moderate increase in activity and some [[Crafting]] [[experience]]. The speed of repairing the barricades is determined by the player's equipped weapon's [[attack speed]], so having a fast speed weapon such as [[dart]]s will allow them to be repaired quickly.
